Hannah Lee: Heads-up: QBR with Sequoia next Thu 9:00 PT. Need final deck, one-pager, and a prioritized action table by Wed noon. Who can own slides and asks?

Owen Park: I will own the onboarding + activation slide. Will pull 30/60/90d cohorts and annotate triggers. ETA Tue evening.

Ravi Shah: I'll take renewal risk + mitigation plan. Using numeric 1-10 risk score. Will include two concrete remediation asks.

Leila Gomez: Demo owner. Prefer live but prepping a 90s recorded fallback + annotated screenshots. Uploading assets Wed 4pm.

qbr-bot: Event created: "Sequoia QBR - Dry Run" Thu 08:00 PT. Reminder 45m prior.

Hannah Lee: Runbook snippet: 1) Hannah open + TLDR (4m) 2) Owen health & adoption (7m) 3) Ravi risk + asks (6m) 4) Leila demo (8m) 5) Q&A (15m). Action list: Owen finalize charts (Wed 10am), Ravi draft one-pager (Wed noon), Leila upload demo assets (Wed 4pm). Mark blockers here.

Owen Park: Small flag  activation metric uses new event name; will note comparability caveat on slide.

Ravi Shah: Finance asked for cost delta for the capacity ask. Looping in Maya; will post numbers Wed AM.

Leila Gomez: Running staging smoke test Tue 9pm. If SSO flares we go recorded.

Hannah Lee: Thanks  please tick off runbook items as you complete them. We'll do an internal dry run Thu 8am PT and an exec slice at 9. :thumbsup:
